summary: Resolved Run 141 Blocking Finding Q1-RA-011 without changing the bounded legacy recognizer contract or the public RunFact model. Reader admission now preserves an internal C1 provenance set alongside the existing RunFact collection. Only Runs admitted through schemaVersion 2/C1 participate in C1 immutable ResultRef validation, C1 artifact generation/current effective-set validation, and C1 verification generation/current verificationSummaryRef validation. schemaVersion 1 Bootstrap Runs remain visible in the final snapshot and retain their normalized legacy status/review facts, but completed legacy revise Runs such as 136/138/140 are no longer required to carry C1 sourceReviewRun/sourceReviewVerdict/reviewVerdictRef tuples; legacy explore/propose are not required to carry C1 producedResultRefs; and legacy review-apply is not promoted into a C1 verification generation. The C1 path remains unchanged in strictness: pending revise uses context predecessor proof without terminal reviewVerdictRef, completed revise requires the full immutable source-review tuple, failed/cancelled never require terminal-only evidence or become successors, and any applicable immutable inputRef/consumedInputRefs/source-review failure still disqualifies successor eligibility. Unknown numeric schema versions continue to fail closed in the existing three-way discriminator. Focused RA-011 fixtures cover real-shape legacy 136/138/140 revise Runs, legacy explore/propose, legacy review-apply, C1 completed revise strictness, and unknown schemaVersion. Delivery Full Test was not run.
